name: ide-gopls
author: lumine-code
description: Provide Go code intelligence through gopls.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to gopls. Leave empty to use an editor-managed copy, then gopls on PATH.

goPath.title: Go Path
goPath.description: Absolute path to the SDK's go or go.exe executable. Leave empty to use go on PATH. The same SDK builds gopls and loads projects while the server runs.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Show a notification when gopls is missing, with an option to install it.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which gopls results the editor uses. These switches can be overridden per grammar without disabling server capabilities.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report syntax errors, type errors and analysis findings.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete names, imports and members while typing.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show type information and documentation on hover.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show call parameters while entering an argument list.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to declarations, types and implementations.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find the uses of a symbol across the workspace.

callHierarchy.title: Call Hierarchy
callHierarchy.description: Show incoming and outgoing function calls.

typeHierarchy.title: Type Hierarchy
typeHierarchy.description: Show related interface and concrete types.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document outlines and project symbol searches.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format Go documents using the configured style.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename a symbol and its references across the project.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer fixes, refactorings and import organization.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show the enabled type and parameter hints inline.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Show actions such as running tests or updating dependencies.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Provide semantic highlighting of Go symbols.

env.title: Go Environment
env.description: Environment variables added to Go commands run by gopls, such as GOOS, GOARCH or CGO_ENABLED.

buildFlags.title: Build Flags
buildFlags.description: Flags passed to the Go build system when discovering packages, such as -tags=integration.

directoryFilters.title: Directory Filters
directoryFilters.description: Include or exclude workspace directories with ordered + and - path prefixes; the last matching filter wins.

gofumpt.title: Gofumpt
gofumpt.description: Use the stricter gofumpt style instead of standard gofmt formatting.

staticcheck.title: Staticcheck
staticcheck.description: Use the subset of Staticcheck analyzers chosen by gopls, enable all of them, or turn them off. All analyzers can increase analysis time.

local.title: Local Import Prefix
local.description: Import path prefix grouped after third-party imports when organizing or adding imports. Leave empty to keep the default grouping.

completeUnimported.title: Complete Unimported Packages
completeUnimported.description: Offer completions from packages that the file has not imported yet.

usePlaceholders.title: Completion Placeholders
usePlaceholders.description: Insert parameter placeholders when completing a function call.

testCodeLens.title: Test Code Lenses
testCodeLens.description: Show run-test actions above Go test and benchmark functions.

hints.title: Inlay Hints
hints.description: The hints gopls supplies when the client and its inlay-hints frontend are enabled.

assignVariableTypes.title: Assignment Types
assignVariableTypes.description: Show inferred types beside short variable declarations.

compositeLiteralFields.title: Literal Fields
compositeLiteralFields.description: Show field names in positional composite literals.

compositeLiteralTypes.title: Literal Types
compositeLiteralTypes.description: Show implicit types in composite literals.

constantValues.title: Constant Values
constantValues.description: Show the evaluated values of constant expressions.

functionTypeParameters.title: Type Parameters
functionTypeParameters.description: Show inferred type arguments of generic functions.

parameterNames.title: Parameter Names
parameterNames.description: Show parameter names beside call arguments.

rangeVariableTypes.title: Range Types
rangeVariableTypes.description: Show inferred types of range variables.
